03
Typography
Type that
earns trust.
Why these two
Personality in headlines. Bricolage gives Bloom Multiverse a distinctive, human voice at large sizes.
Clarity in the product. Instrument Sans stays neutral and readable at the UI’s 12–15px sizes.
Free to use everywhere. Both are open source (SIL OFL) and variable: every weight, no licence cost.
